card.name: Final year digit in citation dates
card.fires_on: The last digit of a publication year inside a reference-list citation, such as 199<<8>> or 200<<3>>, right before the closing parenthesis. It also fires weakly on 'and' in 'Two Days and Two Nights' and on the space after 'every' in dose timing.

modes.label: Citation year digit
modes.description: Final digit of a year in parentheses after author names in a reference entry.
modes.example: Hood, K. K., & Eyberg, S. M. (200<<3>>). Outcomes of parent-child interaction therapy

modes.label: Day and night phrases
modes.description: The linking word in a phrase pairing days with nights.

modes.label: Interval after every
modes.description: The space after 'every' before an hour count in a dosing schedule.

card.writes: It favors time-of-day words like morning, night and day, and suppresses other word starts.
card.plain: It marks the last digit of a year in a reference citation, and a few spots where a span of days or hours is being named.
